name: tryon
description: Virtual Try-On: نظارات، حلق، عقود وميك أب بالكاميرا (React + MediaPipe + Express)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && node scripts/setup-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
